disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any felony or crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The conviction of any felony or the conviction of any crime involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of alcohol or drugs rendering unsafe to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of alcohol or drugs to the extent that such use renders him unsafe to practice dentistry or dental hygiene

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct likely to defraud or deceive the public or patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any unprofessional conduct likely to defraud or to deceive the public or patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentional or negligent conduct causing or likely to cause injury to patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentional or negligent conduct in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene which causes or is likely to cause injury to a patient or patients
Employing or assisting persons whom he knew or had reason to believe were unlicensed to practice dentistry or dental hygiene

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing false, deceptive or misleading advertisements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publishing or causing to be published in any manner an advertisement relating to his professional practice which (i) is false, deceptive or misleading, (ii) contains a claim of superiority, or (iii) violates regulations promulgated by the Board governing advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental or physical incompetence to practice with safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental or physical incompetence to practice his profession with safety to his patients and the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or inducing others to violate statute or regulation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating, assisting, or inducing others to violate any provision of this chapter or any Board regulation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conducting practice contrary to standards of ethics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conducting his practice in a manner contrary to the standards of ethics of dentistry or dental hygiene

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing in manner as to be danger to health and welfare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or causing others to practice in a manner as to be a danger to the health and welfare of his patients or to the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing outside scope of education, training, and experience
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing outside the scope of the dentist's or dental hygienist's education, training, and experience

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing procedure subject to certification without valid certification
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing a procedure subject to certification without such valid certification required by the Board pursuant to § 54.1-2709.1 and Board regulations

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension or restriction of license in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The revocation, suspension or restriction of a license to practice dentistry or dental hygiene in another state, possession or territory of the United States or foreign country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of state or federal drug law or regulation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of any provision of a state or federal law or regulation relating to manufacturing, distributing, dispensing or administering drugs

definition_quote.value: Dentistry means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, and treatment, through surgical, nonsurgical, or related procedures, of diseases, disorders, and conditions of the oral cavity and the maxillofacial, adjacent, and associated structures and their impact on the human body.
definition_quote.quote: Dentistry means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, and treatment, through surgical, nonsurgical, or related procedures, of diseases, disorders, and conditions of the oral cavity and the maxillofacial, adjacent, and associated structures and their impact on the human body.

methods_authorized.quote: the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, and treatment, through surgical, nonsurgical, or related procedures, of diseases, disorders, and conditions of the oral cavity

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe and administer drugs within scope of practice; dental hygienists may administer Schedule VI topical drugs and nitrous oxide under dentist direction
drug_authority.quote: A dentist may also authorize a dental hygienist under his direction to administer Schedule VI nitrous oxide and oxygen inhalation analgesia and, to persons 18 years of age or older, Schedule VI local anesthesia.

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: the Board shall require any dentist who provides or administers sedation or anesthesia in a dental office to obtain either a conscious/moderate sedation permit or a deep sedation/general anesthesia permit issued by the Board

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: The Board shall establish by regulation reasonable education, training, and equipment standards for safe administration and monitoring of sedation and anesthesia to patients in a dental office.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: A licensed dental hygienist may, under the direction or general supervision of a licensed dentist and subject to the regulations of the Board, perform services that are educational, diagnostic, therapeutic, or preventive.

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: No dentist shall employ more than two dental hygienists who practice under remote supervision at one time.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: a dental hygienist may practice dental hygiene under the remote supervision of a dentist who holds an active license by the Board and who has a dental practice physically located in the Commonwealth

value: mobile dentistry program for adults with developmental disabilities
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: A dental hygienist shall only practice under remote supervision at a federally qualified health center; charitable safety net facility; free clinic; long-term care facility; elementary or secondary school; Head Start program; mobile dentistry program for adults with developmental disabilities operated by the Department of Behavioral Health and Developmental Services' Office of Integrated Health; or women, infants, and children (WIC) program.

mobile_dental_facility_registration_requ.quote: No person shall operate a mobile dental clinic or other portable dental operation without first registering such mobile dental clinic or other portable dental operation with the Board

mobile_facility_followup_care_protocol_r.quote: The Board shall promulgate regulations for mobile dental clinics and other portable dental operations to ensure that patient safety is protected, appropriate dental services are rendered, and needed follow-up care is provided.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: No corporation shall be formed or foreign corporation domesticated in the Commonwealth for the purpose of practicing dentistry other than a professional corporation as permitted by Chapter 7 (§ 13.1-542.1 et seq.) of Title 13.1.

opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: The Board shall adopt regulations for the prescribing of opioids, which shall include guidelines for: 1. The treatment of acute pain, which shall include (i) requirements for an appropriate patient history and evaluation, (ii) limitations on dosages or day supply of drugs prescribed

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: a requirement that the prescriber request and review information contained in the Prescription Monitoring Program in accordance with § 54.1-2522.1

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Licensed dentists may employ or engage the services of any person, firm, or corporation to construct or repair an appliance, extraorally, in accordance with a written or digital work order.

teledentistry_authorized.quote: Teledentistry means the delivery of dentistry between a patient and a dentist who holds a license to practice dentistry issued by the Board through the use of telehealth systems and electronic technologies or media, including interactive, two-way audio or video.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: A dentist may also authorize a dental hygienist under his direction to administer Schedule VI nitrous oxide and oxygen inhalation analgesia and, to persons 18 years of age or older, Schedule VI local anesthesia. In its regulations, the Board of Dentistry shall establish the education and training requirements for dental hygienists to administer such controlled substances under a dentist's direction.
